deals.travelWindow: Sep 1 – 8, nonstop Delta flash sale; nonstop fares typically run $190+ into Oct-Nov
deals.whyRanked: The cheapest verified fare of the five at $144 RT nonstop, and the Everglades' Royal Palm entrance is a 45-minute drive from downtown.
deals.soloWhy: South Beach and Wynwood are compact and walkable, the free Metromover covers downtown, and counter-seating Cuban cafes make solo dining easy.

highlights: South Beach's Art Deco Historic District
Everglades airboat tour or Anhinga Trail walk
itinerary: Day 1 — Walk the Art Deco district, swim at South Beach, sunset at the South Pointe Pier.
Day 2 — Wynwood Walls in the morning, Vizcaya Museum and Gardens midday, Little Havana for dinner and live music on Calle Ocho.
Day 3 — Rent a car for the Everglades: the Anhinga Trail boardwalk (alligators, herons) and an airboat tour before an afternoon flight.
guide.gettingAround: The free Metromover covers downtown and Brickell; South Beach is walkable on its own, but a rental car is the easiest way to reach the Everglades.
guide.stayArea: South Beach or Wynwood — walkable, close to the beach or the art district.
food: Wynwood food trucks and Coyo Taco

deals.travelWindow: Aug 26 – 29, cheapest with a connection (Frontier); nonstop Delta fares start around $300
deals.whyRanked: $185 RT is the connecting-flight floor, but Vegas is the rare hub within striking distance of three national parks: Zion, the Grand Canyon, and Death Valley.
deals.soloWhy: The Strip runs 24/7 with counter-seating restaurants, solo-friendly shows, and a monorail that removes any need to rideshare between casinos.

highlights: Red Rock Canyon National Conservation Area (30 min)
Valley of Fire State Park day trip
A Strip food hall for solo-friendly dining
itinerary: Day 1 — Walk the Strip, ride the High Roller at sunset, dinner at a food hall (Eataly or Grand Bazaar Shops).
Day 2 — Morning hike or scenic drive at Red Rock Canyon, evening at Fremont Street downtown.
Day 3 — Rent a car for a Zion or Valley of Fire day trip, or stay closer with a spa day before an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: The Strip monorail and walking cover the casino corridor; a rental car is essential for Zion, Grand Canyon, or Death Valley day trips.
guide.stayArea: Mid-Strip, near a monorail stop — walkable to most casinos and shows.
food: A classic Vegas buffet for the experience

deals.whyRanked: $194 RT nonstop, and Mammoth Cave National Park is under two hours north — an easy day trip from a famously walkable downtown.
deals.soloWhy: The Gulch and downtown are walkable, live-music bars are built around bar-seating for solo visitors, and the crowd is used to people showing up alone for the music.

highlights: Mammoth Cave National Park day trip
itinerary: Day 1 — Broadway honky-tonks and the Country Music Hall of Fame, dinner in the Gulch.
Day 2 — Morning hike at Percy Warner Park, afternoon in East Nashville for coffee and murals, live music at night.
Day 3 — Rent a car for a Mammoth Cave National Park tour (book the cave tour ahead), back to Nashville for an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: Downtown, the Gulch, and East Nashville (via the pedestrian bridge) are walkable; rent a car only for the Mammoth Cave day.
guide.stayArea: The Gulch or East Nashville — walkable, close to music venues and food.

deals.travelWindow: Aug 24 – 31, cheapest with a connection (United); nonstop Delta fares start around $292
deals.whyRanked: $242 RT is the connecting-fare floor, but Phoenix is the closest major airport to both the Grand Canyon and Sedona's red rocks.
deals.soloWhy: Roosevelt Row and downtown are a walkable pocket, but the metro sprawls — plan on a rental car for Sedona or the Grand Canyon.

highlights: Camelback Mountain or Papago Park hike
Roosevelt Row murals and First Fridays art walk
itinerary: Day 1 — Desert Botanical Garden, hike Papago Park's Hole-in-the-Rock, dinner on Roosevelt Row.
Day 2 — Morning hike up Camelback Mountain (Echo Canyon Trail), afternoon in Old Town Scottsdale.
Day 3 — Rent a car for a Sedona day trip: Cathedral Rock or Bell Rock, back to Phoenix for an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: Light rail covers downtown and Tempe; a rental car is essential for Sedona or the Grand Canyon.
guide.stayArea: Roosevelt Row or downtown — walkable, close to the light rail.

deals.travelWindow: Sep 29 – Oct 3, cheapest with a connection (JetBlue); nonstop Delta fares from $257
deals.whyRanked: The priciest of the five at $244 RT, but El Yunque National Forest is 45 minutes away and Old San Juan is one of the most walkable historic districts for a solo trip.
deals.soloWhy: Old San Juan's cobblestone core is compact, well-lit, and covered by a free trolley — no car needed until you head out for El Yunque.

highlights: Old San Juan's cobblestone streets and La Perla
El Yunque National Forest hike (La Mina Falls)
Bioluminescent bay night kayak in Fajardo (day trip)
itinerary: Day 1 — Walk Old San Juan: El Morro, the cathedral, La Perla, dinner on Calle Fortaleza.
Day 2 — Rent a car or book a van tour to El Yunque National Forest, hike to La Mina Falls, back for sunset at Condado Beach.
Day 3 — Bioluminescent bay night kayak tour in Fajardo, or a relaxed beach morning before an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: Old San Juan and Condado are walkable, with a free trolley in the old city; rent a car or book a tour van for El Yunque or the bio bay.
guide.stayArea: Old San Juan or Condado — walkable, close to the beach or the historic core.
food: Mofongo at a local kiosko in Piñones
